price.label: Share price ($)
price.source: Benzinga quote page, last updated Oct 15, 2026 (header shows $31.90; FAQ shows $32.12).

shares.label: Diluted shares (millions)
shares.source: Q2 2026 earnings release: diluted average shares 529.5M.

dps.label: Dividend per share ($/yr)
dps.source: Benzinga: 5.80% yield at $31.90 → $1.85/share; policy maintained through 2026 per Q4 2025 call.

chg_ytd.label: Share price change, year to date

gross_debt.label: Gross debt
gross_debt.source: Q2 2026 balance sheet: notes payable/current maturities $1,002M + long-term debt $8,215M. Excludes $2,131M nonrecourse VIE liabilities.

pen_us_q_assets.label: Pension, U.S. qualified plan: assets
pen_us_q_assets.source: 10-K MD&A: 'U.S. qualified pension $ 8,116 $ 8,482' (benefit obligation, fair value of plan assets).

pen_us_q_pbo.label: Pension, U.S. qualified plan: obligation (PBO)
pen_us_q_pbo.source: Same table. The plan is overfunded: 'a surplus of $366 million'.

pen_uk_surplus.label: Pension, UK qualified plan (DS Smith): surplus
pen_uk_surplus.source: 10-K MD&A: 'an overfunded UK qualified pension with a surplus of $112 million.'

pen_us_nq.label: Pension, U.S. nonqualified plans: obligation, no assets
pen_us_nq.source: 10-K MD&A: 'U.S. nonqualified pension 218 —'. Paid as benefits come due ($49M in 2025).

pen_net.label: Pensions, all plans: assets above obligations (the filing's net)
pen_net.source: 10-K MD&A: 'the projected benefit obligation ... was approximately $144 million lower than the fair value of plan assets.' Note 19: U.S. plans +$148M, non-U.S. −$4M.

pen_surplus.label: Pension plans in surplus, total (not counted by default)
pen_surplus.source: 10-K Note 19, noncurrent assets: U.S. $367M + non-U.S. $119M = $486M (balance sheet: Overfunded Pension Plan Assets $486M).

pen_deficit.label: Pension plans in deficit, total (counted, after tax)
pen_deficit.source: 10-K Note 19, liabilities: U.S. $21M current + $198M noncurrent, non-U.S. $5M current + $118M noncurrent = $342M (balance sheet: Underfunded Pension Benefit Obligations $316M long-term).

opeb.label: Retiree medical and postemployment benefits (counted, after tax)
opeb.source: 10-K balance sheet: Postretirement and Postemployment Benefit Obligation $133M. Note 19 calls the other postretirement plans 'not considered material' and gives no table.

op_leases.label: Operating lease liabilities (not counted: the lease cost is already inside EBITDA)
op_leases.source: 10-K Note 10: operating lease liabilities $221M current (other current liabilities) + $486M noncurrent (long-term lease obligations); 2025 operating lease cost $258M. Under U.S. GAAP operating lease cost is an operating expense, so EBITDA is after rent; adding the liability too would count it twice.

fin_leases.label: Finance lease liabilities (not counted again: already inside gross debt)
fin_leases.source: 10-K Note 10: finance lease liabilities $17M in notes payable and current maturities of long-term debt + $54M in long-term debt.

env_reserve.label: Environmental remediation reserves, old mill sites (counted, after tax)
env_reserve.source: 10-K Note 14: 'International Paper's estimated probable liability for these environmental matters, totaled approximately $270 million' at Dec 31, 2025 (Cass Lake, Kalamazoo River, San Jacinto, Versailles Pond among them). Remediation is a special item, outside adjusted EBITDA.

asbestos.label: Asbestos claims, net of insurance (counted, after tax)
asbestos.source: 10-K Note 14: 'total recorded liability with respect to pending and future asbestos-related claims was $103 million ... net of insurance recoveries'.

brazil_booked.label: Brazil tax guarantee to Sylvamo, already booked (counted in full)
brazil_booked.source: 10-K Note 14: 'The initial fair value estimate and recorded liability as of December 31, 2021 was $48 million and remains this amount at December 31, 2025.'

timber_dtl.label: Deferred tax on the Temple-Inland timber notes, due 2027 (counted)
timber_dtl.source: 10-K, contractual obligations: '$487 million deferred tax liability related to the Temple-Inland timber monetization, which will be settled with the maturity of the notes in 2027.'

vie_assets.label: Timber notes held by the special purpose entities (counted, net of the loans)
vie_assets.source: 10-K balance sheet: Long-Term Financial Assets of Variable Interest Entities $2,349M. Note 15: $2.4B face, due 2027, backed by letters of credit from three banks.

vie_liab.label: Nonrecourse loans against those notes
vie_liab.source: 10-K balance sheet: Long-Term Nonrecourse Financial Liabilities of Variable Interest Entities $2,127M. Not in gross debt above; the notes repay them in 2027.

debt_2027.label: Regular debt maturing in 2027 (context, not added)

utb.label: Unrecognized tax benefits (not counted: timing and amount uncertain)
utb.source: 10-K contractual obligations footnote: 'approximately $344 million of unrecognized tax benefits'.

brazil_tax.label: Brazil tax matter via the Sylvamo agreement, IP's potential share (counted only the $48M booked)
brazil_tax.source: 10-K Risk Factors: 'our potential liability for such assessments would currently be approximately $274 million' (assessments total about $394M, 2007–2015 tax years).

count_surplus.label: Count the pension surplus too? (1 = yes, 0 = no)
count_surplus.source: Default no: a surplus can't be spent without an excise tax or years of contribution holidays. Set 1 to net it against the deficits.

pension_other.label: Debt-like items, after tax (from the 10-K lines above)
pension_other.source: Pension deficits, retiree medical, environmental and asbestos reserves, after tax; the booked Brazil guarantee; the 2027 timber tax less the equity in the timber structure (notes less loans); minus the pension surplus only if counted. Operating leases excluded.

rev_2025_na.label: 2025 pro forma net sales — Packaging Solutions NA
rev_2025_na.source: Q4 2025 call: 'over $15B' pro forma for the North American business (rounded).

rev_2025_emea.label: 2025 pro forma net sales — Packaging Solutions EMEA
rev_2025_emea.source: Q4 2025 call: about $8.5B pro forma for EMEA (DS Smith full year).

fcf_2025.label: 2025 free cash flow
fcf_2025.source: Q4 2025 call: free cash flow of negative $159M, reflecting transformation investment.

ebitda_2026_h1.label: H1 2026 adj. EBITDA
ebitda_2026_h1.source: Q2 2026 release: six-month adjusted EBITDA $1,264M (Q1 $677M, Q2 $587M).

ebitda_2026_guide_lo.label: 2026 adj. EBITDA guidance — low
ebitda_2026_guide_lo.source: Q2 2026 release: $3.2–3.4B. (January: $3.5–3.7B; cut in April on demand, inflation, Middle East freight.)

ebitda_2026_guide_jan_lo.label: 2026 adj. EBITDA guidance in January — low
ebitda_2026_guide_jan_lo.source: Q4 2025 call (Jan 29, 2026): $3.5–3.7B, cut to $3.2–3.4B in April.

ebitda_2026_guide_jan_hi.label: 2026 adj. EBITDA guidance in January — high

fcf_2026_guide_mid.label: 2026 free cash flow guidance (Jan, midpoint)
fcf_2026_guide_mid.source: Q4 2025 call: $300–500M FCF for 2026 (pre-April cut; not updated in the Q2 release).

sep_costs_2026.label: Separation / transaction costs expected 2026–27
sep_costs_2026.source: Q2 2026 alone: $43M separation costs + $5M NORPAC costs + $9M 80/20 severance. Annualized run-rate ~$250M through the spin; your call.

price_index_ytd.label: 2026 containerboard index increase recognized YTD ($/ton, linerboard)
price_index_ytd.source: Fastmarkets RISI via Packaging Dive (Sept 18, 2026): −20 Feb, +40 Mar, +30 Apr, +50 Jun, +70 Sep ≈ +$170/ton linerboard; medium +$100 in Sept alone.

price_sens.label: EBITDA per $1/ton of price (annualized, NA)
price_sens.source: CFO Lance Loeffler, Q4 2025 call: each $10/ton ≈ $90M annualized adjusted EBITDA.

price_in_2026.label: Price benefit already inside 2026 NA guidance
price_in_2026.source: Q1 2026 call: IP expects pricing to add ~$175M to NA in 2026, mostly in H2.

stick_pct.label: Share of the YTD index gain that STICKS through 2027 (floor judgment)
stick_pct.source: Q1 for Jason: of the $170/ton announced, what holds at the box level in 12 months? Green Markets found no evidence the third round reached the open market (Sept). Default 50%.

vol_2027_na.label: NA box volume growth 2027
vol_2027_na.source: Market flat in 2026 (TTOBMA cut containerboard to −2%); IP claims +3–4 pts vs market. Default +1%.

contrib_margin.label: Contribution margin on incremental NA volume
contrib_margin.source: Incremental box volume through existing mills/plants; typical converter contribution 25–35%.

costout_2027.label: Incremental 80/20 cost-out 2027 (NA + EMEA)
costout_2027.source: ~$510M run-rate benefits in 2025, 'similar' expected in 2026 (Q4 2025 call); EMEA >$200M run-rate from 31 closures. Default $300M for 2027, fading.

inflation_2027.label: Cost inflation 2027 (OCC, energy, labor, freight)
inflation_2027.source: OCC back to ~$80–100/ton from 2025 lows (5-yr avg $140); freight up on Middle East; EMEA inflation ~$100M in 2026 guide. Default $250M.

emea_2027_delta.label: EMEA EBITDA change 2027 (box-price catch-up + cost-out, net)
emea_2027_delta.source: Q2 2026: EMEA lost money because paper prices rose faster than box prices. Catch-up + cost-out vs soft demand. Default +$150M.

midcycle_na_margin.label: Mid-cycle NA adj. EBITDA margin (2028+)
midcycle_na_margin.source: SW 15% LTM, PKG 21% LTM, IP NA 2026E ~15.9%. Bull = toward PKG after 80/20; bear = below SW. Default 17%.

rev_growth_lt.label: Revenue growth 2028–2030 (nominal)
rev_growth_lt.source: Box demand ≈ GDP-ish plus price; 2.5% nominal.

capex_2027.label: Capex 2027
capex_2027.source: 2026 run-rate ~$2.1B incl. Riverdale conversion ($250M project) and $225M Mississippi greenfield (opens Q4 2027). Default $1.9B.

capex_pct_lt.label: Capex as % of revenue 2028+ (maintenance + modest growth)
capex_pct_lt.source: Paper is capex-heavy: D&A ≈ 8% of sales today. 6.5% assumes the transformation capex rolls off. Your 'assets in the ground are expensive to run' point lives here.

nwc_pct.label: Net working capital investment, % of incremental revenue
nwc_pct.source: Packaging converters typically carry 8–12% of sales in NWC.

tax_rate.label: Cash tax rate
tax_rate.source: US 21% federal + state, blended with EMEA. Check against the 10-K effective rate.

rf.label: Risk-free rate (10-yr US Treasury)
rf.source: Placeholder near the Oct 2026 10-yr yield — refresh before publishing.

beta.label: Equity beta
beta.source: IP 5-yr regression beta has run ~1.0–1.2; Damodaran paper/forest products industry beta ~1.0. Default 1.10.

erp.label: Equity risk premium
erp.source: Damodaran implied ERP has run 4–5% in 2025–26.

kd.label: Pre-tax cost of debt
kd.source: IP senior unsecured notes have traded ~5–6% yield (BBB-range credit). Refresh.

g.label: Terminal growth rate
g.source: At or below long-run nominal GDP for a mature, capex-heavy business.

exit_mult.label: Exit EV/EBITDA multiple (cross-check)
exit_mult.source: IP's own 10-yr average ~8–9x; SW 7.2x and PKG 12.2x today.

pkg_ev_ebitda.label: PKG EV/EBITDA (LTM)
pkg_ev_ebitda.source: Multiples.vc Oct 17, 2026; EV $25B, LTM revenue $9.8B, EBITDA margin 21%.

sw_ev_ebitda.label: Smurfit Westrock EV/EBITDA (LTM)
sw_ev_ebitda.source: Multiples.vc Oct 15, 2026; EV $35B, LTM revenue $32B, EBITDA margin 15%.

scenario.label: Active scenario (1 = Bear, 2 = Mid-cycle, 3 = Bull) — drives the Scenarios sheet overrides
scenario.source: The Model sheet uses the Inputs above directly; the Scenarios sheet runs all three side by side.
